messages.content: I agree this works well for the criterion on inhibition of LH preventing ovulation and thus no egg to fertilise. The phrase "They also inhibit LH, preventing ovulation, so an egg is not released for fertilisation" clearly states the hormone inhibited, the consequence, and the resulting absence of an egg. It directly matches the mark scheme requirement. I don't think further checks are needed here unless you want to verify the overall context of their hormone explanation.

criterion.text: o inhibition of LH (production / release) - lack of LH prevents ovulation - therefore there is no egg to fertilise
